finalText:
**Migration finished.** 12 files still used the old call. All 36 sites now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

I left two things alone on purpose:
- `cache.query(...)` is a different thing. It is not the database.
- `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` is vendored. Edits there vanish on upgrade.

`node verify.js` passes: `OK every db.query call site moved to db.execute, and nothing else moved`.
